intro: Everyone at Aldwell University expects plus-size freshman Tanya Jordan to be dumped by her rich fiancé, Ethan Cross. It reads like a campus romance novel, now on screen: the engagement is only a one-year deal to save her family, until Ethan's dangerous older brother, Leo, learns Tanya is the girl who saved his life thirteen years ago. Leo falls for her openly, Ethan realizes his feelings are no longer fake, and neither brother will let her go.
why: A fake-engagement romance that turns into a real love triangle.
Tanya goes from the girl everyone expects to be dumped to the one both brothers want.
Good pick if you like campus romance, brothers as rivals and a heroine who is underestimated.
